summary.text: Ignited Thought Flying Rock is one of Purple Mountain True Monarch's wisdom path killer moves. He used it among other methods to face Duke Long when he was not in peak condition.

claims.text: In Lang Ya blessed land, Fang Yuan chooses to modify Purple Mountain True Monarch’s wisdom path killer moves because they are powerful, he has grandmaster wisdom path attainment, and he already holds a batch of wisdom path Immortal Gu left behind by Purple Mountain True Monarch. Ignited thought flying rock is named in that batch with purple blood river formation, purple thought light shield, single thought flower blossom, purple thought perception starlight, directional confusion fog, thought body defense, and single thought myriad flow elimination.

On cloud soil, Fang Yuan calls the move in his mind. His eyes flicker with crystal purple light, thoughts clash, and small rocks resembling charcoal appear around his body. They seem to burn without heat. On his will they shoot out in silence, expand from thumb size to basin size to the size of horse carriages, and become giant rocks blazing with red flames. Hundreds become thousands and dye the sky red. They land as a field of flames with neither heat nor sound, because they are not real blazing rocks: they are formed from thoughts. This is Purple Mountain True Monarch’s main attacking method, and it can burn the target’s thoughts. After the rocks explode, a consecutive move, single thought flower blossom, can make flowers bloom in the pits; on cloud soil without thoughts those flowers are only decorations. Fang Yuan’s versions of these wisdom path killer moves are already modified to some extent.
Against an immemorial myriad head coiling dragon in Tai Qiu, countless flaming rocks land on its body and a large number of dragon heads fall. Thoughts of getting up are extinguished by the flames.
The beast had just woken and was countered by wisdom path killer moves. Charging in would have cost Fang Yuan more effort; ignited thought flying rock deals with it easily.

In green ghost desert in Western Desert, Fang Yuan points his finger and uses ignited thought flying rock as a wisdom path immortal killer move against Old Ghost Bai Jun. Offense meets offense: dark currents resist, then disperse. The red meteorites lose half their power and still smash the ground, killing or heavily injuring many of Old Ghost Bai Jun’s soul beasts.

Old Ghost Bai Jun later bursts with aura, brushes the rocks aside, and charges. Fang Yuan had meant to capture him with wisdom path methods, then judged that those methods originated from Purple Mountain True Monarch. The ignited thought flying rock he had just used could be hidden, and after his modification its effect had changed a lot, but other wisdom path methods would be more likely to be recognized, so he switches to soul path.

Stepping out of Fallen Flower Hall, Fang Yuan stretches his finger as meteors rain down. Old Ghost Bai Jun uses two immemorial soul beasts as a shield. The rocks crash into the desert and make a sea of fire for several li with no heat: unique thought fire that spreads and burns on Old Ghost Bai Jun, who cannot spare the effort to dodge.

Through Fang Di Chang’s flowery wind warriors, Fang Yuan instills the move into a warrior that detonates above Divine Bean Palace. Thought rocks crash down, and three immemorial soul beasts ignite with thought flames and shake.

Against Thunder Ghost True Monarch Jing Lan, Fang Yuan pushes his palms forward and meteorites with long blazing tails smash toward her. She shows disdain at ignited thought flying rock. After turning into lightning she charges straight through those rocks while detouring around purple thought perception starlight.

Fang Yuan judges that some killer moves can be refined into one Gu worm, but ignited thought flying rock cannot. Condensed to its limit, it comprises multiple Immortal Gu that still need to be coordinated to use the killer move.

Known users.text: Purple Mountain True Monarch Fang Yuan
